title: IDF Chief Zamir Tours Gaza, Vows to Bring Every October 7 Perpetrator 'to Justice'
detail: IDF Chief of Staff Lt. Gen. Eyal Zamir toured the Gaza Strip on Wednesday, August 5, 2026, telling troops the military has been 'systematically striking Hamas' and has 'significantly weakened [Hamas] and changed the security reality.' Zamir vowed the IDF 'will continue to operate proactively. We will not allow a threat to emerge on our borders as we experienced on October 7,' and said the military 'will not relent until we bring every person who played a part in the [October 7] massacre to justice.' The remarks came a day after Prime Minister Netanyahu declared Israel has not agreed to a US-backed Hamas disarmament proposal that would require halting military operations in Gaza — underscoring that the manhunt for October 7 planners, which has already killed senior Hamas commanders Mohammed Sinwar, Shambari, Izz al-Din al-Haddad, and Mohammed Odeh since 2024, remains an active IDF priority even as ceasefire diplomacy continues.
